review_candidates.title: Functioneel Beheerder Microsoft 365
review_candidates.description: Als functioneel beheerder M365 bij OGD help je organisaties in de zorg, overheid en het onderwijs om meer uit hun digitale werkplek te halen. Je werkt voor één of meerdere klanten in regio Zuid-Holland, Utrecht, Amsterdam, Eindhoven of Arnhem. Je zorgt ervoor dat Microsoft 365 niet alleen goed is ingericht, maar ook goed aansluit op de manier waarop mensen samenwerken. In overleg werk je hybride. Waarom deze baan leuk is Bij OGD werk je als functioneel beheerder in verschillende klantomgevingen. De ene keer help je een zorgorganisatie met het verbeteren van samenwerking in Teams, de andere keer richt je een SharePoint-omgeving slimmer in voor een onderwijsinstelling of overheidsorganisatie. Juist die afwisseling maakt het werk interessant. Je ziet veel verschillende organisaties van binnen, werkt aan uiteenlopende vraagstukken en bouwt in korte tijd brede ervaring op binnen Microsoft 365. Daarbij sta je er niet alleen voor. Je werkt samen met andere functioneel beheerders en consultants die net als jij bezig zijn met het slimmer inrichten en verbeteren van digitale werkplekken. Zo kun je sparren met collega’s, van elkaar leren en jezelf verder ontwikkelen in het vak. Wat ga je doen? Als functioneel beheerder M365 zorg jij dat gebruikers prettig en effectief kunnen werken met Microsoft 365. Je haalt wensen op, denkt mee over de beste inrichting en vertaalt vragen naar oplossingen die in de praktijk werken. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: het vertalen van die wensen naar praktische oplossingen binnen Microsoft 365; het inrichten en verbeteren van omgevingen in bijvoorbeeld Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Forms, Power Apps en Power Automate; het ondersteunen van gebruikers bij vragen, verzoeken en incidenten; het testen en doorvoeren van aanpassingen en nieuwe functionaliteiten; het bijhouden van documentatie, werkinstructies en kennisartikelen; het meedenken over hoe de digitale werkplek overzichtelijker, gebruiksvriendelijker en slimmer ingericht kan worden. In deze rol combineer je functioneel beheer met veel contact met gebruikers. Je vindt het dus leuk om goed te luisteren, helder uit te leggen hoe iets werkt en collega’s of klanten verder te helpen. Wat neem je mee? je hebt bij voorkeur een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, maar in ieder geval minimaal een behaalde propedeuse. je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als functioneel beheerder, applicatiebeheerder of in een vergelijkbare rol; je hebt ervaring met Microsoft 365, bijvoorbeeld met Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Forms, Power Apps of Power Automate; je hebt basiskennis van Microsoft Purview, bijvoorbeeld van sensitivity labels, dataclassificatie en informatiebescherming; je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen Microsoft 365, zoals Copilot, met interesse; je communiceert helder en prettig in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; je helpt graag gebruikers en collega’s verder; je werkt nauwkeurig, denkt analytisch en houdt overzicht; ervaring met ITIL-processen is mooi meegenomen. Wat krijg je van ons? een salaris dat op kan lopen tot €4.900,- euro per maand (afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring); een jaarcontract en de intentie om dit na een jaar te verlengen voor onbepaalde tijd; alle perks die horen bij werken bij de grootste Microsoft Cloud Solutions Partner van Nederland (lees hier meer); 26 vakantiedagen op basis van een werkweek van 40 uur; een pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding; een NS Business Card voor woon-werk verkeer (2e klas); een goede werk-privé balans en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken; vele opleidings- (zowel intern als extern) en doorgroeimogelijkheden; vele activiteiten zoals (bord)spelavonden en ons jaarlijkse festival: Technival; een MVO-bewuste organisatie met toffe initiatieven en oog voor diversiteit (lees hier over MVO & over diversiteit); een overzicht van alle arbeidsvoorwaarden kun je hier vinden.

review_candidates.title: Analista de Command Center
review_candidates.description: Sobre a empresa Desde 2012, a WEAI trabalha dentro da operação de empresas de médio e grande porte. Montamos e sustentamos Command Centers, NOC, SOC e ITSM , com monitoramento 24x7, automação e governança de TI. Dessa rotina nasceu o weCortex.AI , nossa tecnologia própria de IA aplicada. Ele conecta observabilidade, logs, ITSM e base de conhecimento para diagnosticar incidentes, recomendar a correção e executá-la com segurança. Hoje são mais de 150 projetos entregues , mais de 60 clientes ativos em 4 continentes e um time com mais de 100 certificações. Nossa sede fica em Alphaville, Barueri/SP. Nossa missão: acelerar a transformação das operações com IA aplicada, com resultado medido, segurança e governança. Descrição da vaga O Analista de Command Center é um membro essencial da nossa equipe de operações, responsável por monitorar e manter a estabilidade dos sistemas de computadores e de rede da organização. Esse papel requer uma combinação de habilidades técnicas sólidas (hard skills) e competências interpessoais (soft skills) para garantir um funcionamento eficiente e sem interrupções dos sistemas críticos. Responsabilidades e atribuições Monitoramento de Sistemas Críticos: Monitorar constantemente os sistemas da organização, incluindo servidores, redes, aplicativos e bancos de dados, utilizando ferramentas avançadas de monitoramento para identificar problemas e tomar medidas proativas. Resolução de Incidentes: tratativas em primeiro nível para incidentes em ambientes de infraestrutura física e virtual, banco de dados, redes, aplicações, etc. Documentação: Manter registros detalhados de incidentes, procedimentos de resolução e documentação de sistemas para futuras referências e melhoria contínua. Escalonamento: Identificar e priorizar incidentes críticos que exijam escalonamento para a equipe de nível 2 ou para especialistas técnicos. Atualização e Manutenção: Realizar atualizações de software e aplicar patches de segurança de acordo com as políticas e procedimentos estabelecidos. Comunicação Eficaz em ambiente crítico: Possuir excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir de forma clara e eficaz com os usuários e colegas. Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborar de maneira eficaz com outros membros da equipe do Command Center e de outros departamentos para abordar e resolver problemas de forma conjunta. Resolução de Problemas: Demonstrar habilidades analíticas sólidas e a capacidade de pensar criticamente para resolver problemas técnicos de maneira eficiente. Adaptabilidade: Ser capaz de se adaptar rapidamente a situações em constante mudança e a prioridades variáveis em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado. Paciência e Empatia: Mostrar paciência ao lidar com usuários que podem estar enfrentando dificuldades técnicas e demonstrar empatia em relação às suas necessidades. Orientação para o Cliente: Manter um foco na satisfação do cliente ao fornecer suporte técnico e resolver problemas. Requisitos e qualificações Graduação ou formação técnica em informática, tecnologia da informação ou campo relacionado. Conhecimento sólido em sistemas operacionais (Windows, Linux), redes e protocolos. Requisitos desejáveis Experiência prévia em funções similares é preferencial. Certificações relevantes em tecnologia ou redes são uma vantagem. Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos rotativos, incluindo noites e fins de semana, conforme necessário. Benefícios Oportunidade de atuação em novos projetos e desafios internos Acesso a novas tecnologias e desenvolvimento profissional Alura – Acesso á todo conteúdo da plataforma, sem custo Wellhub – Acesso para o colaborador e até 4 dependentes Clube Ifood – Cupons de desconto, entregas gratuitas, desconto em parceiros Starbem – Aplicativo de assistência à Saúde (Com inclusão de dependentes) Avus - Soluções de Saúde e Bem-estar (Com inclusão de dependentes) Dasa +Saúde – Exames, acompanhamentos médicos e descontos Optum – Apoio na gestão de saúde, como ajuda psicológica, orientação jurídica e financeira Convênio Amil – 70% pago pelo colaborador – 30% pago pela empresa

review_candidates.title: Application Support Engineer - London, UK
review_candidates.description: Role – Operations Associate Consultant Technology – End User Computing Location – London Compensation – Competitive (including bonus) Job Description The EUC / Desktop & Application Support Engineer will provide end-user computing, application, device, and technical support within a fast-paced financial services environment. The role includes Level 1 and Level 2 support, application troubleshooting, mobile and endpoint support, incident management, market data and trading application support, trader voice coordination, and escalation management. The role requires strong technical troubleshooting capabilities, excellent customer service, ownership of incidents and complex issues, and effective collaboration with local and global support and engineering teams. At Infosys, we assure that your career will never stand still, we will inspire you to build what’s next and we will navigate further together. Our journey of learnability, values and trusted relationships with our clients continue to be the cornerstones of our organization and these values are upheld only because of our people. End-User & Application Support Troubleshoot, diagnose, repair, and maintain end-user software applications. Install, configure, upgrade, and support software applications. Provide support for laptops, mobile phones, tablets, and associated end-user devices. Support operating system drivers, software, and firmware. Provide support for standalone systems and Level 1 connectivity-related issues. Act as an escalation point for the Help Desk/Service Desk for application-related incidents. Support a broad range of in-house, third-party, market data, and trading applications. Provide technical escalation support for Level 1 and Level 2 support teams. Financial Services & Trading Environment Support Provide support within a financial services/banking environment, including business-critical user requirements. Support market data and trading applications such as Bloomberg. Provide Level 1 support for trader voice-related issues and coordinate with appropriate SMEs for advanced troubleshooting and resolution. Support firm-wide client and business events, including end-user technology setup, readiness checks, and technical support. Understand the actual and potential business impact of technical incidents and prioritize/escalate accordingly. Incident, Problem & Escalation Management Record, update, manage, and track all incidents and service requests through the designated IT service management/ticketing platform. Take ownership of technical incidents and complex problems through to resolution or appropriate escalation. Perform and/or coordinate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring or complex technical issues. Identify recurring trends, significant service issues, and potential risks and proactively communicate these to management. Triage escalations received through multiple support channels and ensure appropriate routing and follow-up. Work in alignment with established ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Outage Management processes. Provide appropriate operational and service reporting. Stakeholder & Cross-Team Collaboration Collaborate with local and global support teams across multiple technology platforms. Work effectively with senior engineering teams and specialist technical towers to resolve complex issues. Coordinate with SMEs and other technical teams when incidents require specialist investigation or escalation. Maintain effective communication with end users, business stakeholders, support teams, and management throughout the incident lifecycle. Proactively respond to support requests received through multiple communication channels, including email, Microsoft Teams, ticketing platforms, and voice hotlines. Operational Governance & Documentation Create, maintain, and regularly update technical support documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles. Independently manage recurring operational routines and identify opportunities to address process or service gaps. Ensure applicable organizational policies, operating instructions, procedures, and control requirements are followed and communicated. Complete required training programs and acknowledge relevant Operating Instructions (OIs) as required. Required Skills & Experience Strong hands-on experience in EUC/Desktop Support, Application Support, or End-User Technology Support. Experience supporting Windows-based laptops, mobile phones, tablets, software applications, drivers, and firmware. Good technical understanding of a wide range of in-house and third-party enterprise applications. Experience using IT help desk/service management ticketing systems. Strong understanding of Level 1 and Level 2 support processes and escalation procedures. Working knowledge of ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Outage Management processes. Ability to perform troubleshooting, incident triage, root cause analysis, and technical escalation. Ability to assess the business impact and urgency of technology incidents. Experience working with technical SMEs and senior engineering teams. Experience supporting standalone systems and basic connectivity issues. Strong documentation and operational reporting skills. Preferred Experience Previous experience providing end-user technology support within banking, financial services, investment banking, or trading environments. Experience supporting market data and trading applications, particularly Bloomberg. Experience supporting or coordinating issues relating to trader voice systems. Experience providing technology support for business-critical or firm-wide client events. Experience working in a global support model involving multiple technical teams and locations. Key Competencies Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Strong interpersonal and customer-service skills suitable for a client-facing environment. Professional and customer-focused approach to end-user support. Strong ownership and accountability for incidents and service requests. Ability to work effectively under pressure and within tight resolution timelines. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capability. Ability to prioritize multiple incidents and requests based on urgency and business impact. Ability to communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive approach to identifying service trends, risks, recurring problems, and improvement opportunities. Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively with local and global teams. We enable them with an AI-first core, empower the business with agile digital at scale and drive continuous improvement with always-on learning through the transfer of digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.
